GERMAN — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #17
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Reading 2.2.2 Intensive Reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 2.2.2 Intensive Reading.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Reading 2.2.2 Intensive Reading.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Reading 2.2.2 Intensive Reading.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 2.2.2 Intensive Reading.

2. When practising Grammar 1.4.1 Verbs and Pronouns, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Grammar 1.4.1 Verbs and Pronouns.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Grammar 1.4.1 Verbs and Pronouns.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Grammar 1.4.1 Verbs and Pronouns.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Grammar 1.4.1 Verbs and Pronouns.

3. When practising Reading 1.2.2 Reading Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 1.2.2 Reading Comprehension.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Reading 1.2.2 Reading Comprehension.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 1.2.2 Reading Comprehension.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Reading 1.2.2 Reading Comprehension.

4. When practising Grammar, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Grammar.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Grammar.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Grammar.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Grammar.

5. When practising Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Conversational skills, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Conversational skills.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Conversational skills.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Conversational skills.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Conversational skills.

6. German for “school” is: (1 mark)
   A. Haus
   B. Wasser
   C. Schule
   D. Buch

7. When practising Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Dialogic Skills, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Dialogic Skills.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Dialogic Skills.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Dialogic Skills.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Dialogic Skills.

8. When practising Writing 2.3.2 Descriptive writing, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 2.3.2 Descriptive writing.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Writing 2.3.2 Descriptive writing.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 2.3.2 Descriptive writing.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Writing 2.3.2 Descriptive writing.

9. When practising Writing 1.3.1: Descriptive writing, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 1.3.1: Descriptive writing.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Writing 1.3.1: Descriptive writing.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 1.3.1: Descriptive writing.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Writing 1.3.1: Descriptive writing.

10. “Guten Tag” means: (1 mark)
   A. Please
   B. Thank you
   C. Good day / hello
   D. Good night

11. When practising Reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Reading.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Reading.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Reading.

12. When practising Writing, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Writing.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Writing.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Writing.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Writing 1.3.1: Descriptive writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Grammar and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Grammar 1.4.1 Verbs and Pronouns and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

====

2. C — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Grammar 1.4.1 Verbs and Pronouns.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Writing; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Writing 1.3.1: Descriptive writing; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Grammar; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
